authority_policy: Promote only when the historical item is matched to a first-party organizer-hosted question paper or equivalent persistent official question source. An official answer key, secondary attribution, coaching registry, or local donor verification alone is insufficient. Learner-facing wording remains PYQ_ADAPTED unless exact source custody is authorized.

dedup_audit.policy: No donor item is promoted merely because it duplicates or resembles another donor. Variant groups remain quarantined until one source identity is authoritative.

source_lineage_sweep.disposition: Organizer-hosted historical question papers are persistent and item-level matches are promotable after independent answer checks.

NEET 2020 English Set E1 has a persistent organizer-hosted question paper plus NTA final answer key and is used here. Later-year archive entries located in this pass did not provide the same persistent paper corpus, so unmatched candidates remain held.
